title: Long-cycle BTC trend persistence and delay-cost ablation

design.population: All 39 preexisting raw weekly trend entries 2011-2026 from v8.7; never add/remove after performance review
design.clock: A raw entry into weekly boolean upward trend is fixed at its historical fully closed Sunday; persistence confirmation at (N-1) future fully closed Sundays, not backdated. If trend lost before N confirmations, record NOT_CONFIRMED and no price/cycle results from would-be confirmation.
design.forwardOutcome: Reference BTC fixing Sunday future close ratio minus 1, and minimum intervening daily close versus confirmation reference price, only if full future available. A Sunday must be completed before signal; no live Oct18 day.
design.entryOpportunityCost: For confirmed episodes, mark percent price change from original raw first Sunday close to actual confirmation Sunday close. A larger positive fraction is opportunity foregone for early recognition but not trading P&L.
design.growthPersistenceProxy: Descriptive 26-week price progress proxy positive if return26w >= +20%, 26-week path worst daily close > -20% relative to confirmation close. Contrasting 26-week failure proxy if return26w<=-20% OR path worst daily close<=-20%. All other cases MIXED; CENSORED when future26w unavailable. NOT a true macro bull or bear label.
design.falseSignalProxy: For preexisting entries, later loss of weekly flag within 4 or 13 subsequent complete Sunday closings. This is technical-signal failure, not necessarily a bear cycle.
design.breadth: At confirmed date report frozen PriceUSD 30d ETH/BTC and six-alt breadth only when eight-asset data actually available, then within 13w count broadening versus trend loss. If no complete full universe, UNKNOWN (not no alt strength).
design.comparison: Compare cohorts at 1w,2w,4w,8w persistence on same original entry population: coverage/excluded, delay weeks, entry-to-confirm movement, 13w/26w median and worst close drawdown, censoring. Do not compare event outcomes from different clock times as if same trade policy; mark selection and delay.
design.sensitivity: Collapse raw-entry events by a 13-week gap and report confirmation statistics; other variants independent only in spacing, not economic cycle. Do not fit/optimize the thresholds based on results.
design.current: At 2026-10-11 last Sunday, the raw trend entered 2026-09-13 (five completed weeks), so 1/2/4 weeks confirmations should be testable, 8wk not; no future outcomes from current checkpoint.
design.macroGuard: Current external ETF and Fed source contextual only; release timestamp/PIT-vintage verification lacking means NO new macro score in v8.8. Forward financial conditions study is independent frozen follow-up.

integrity: Verify pinned R2 SHA for v8.6/v8.7 and archived manifest
Verify exact 814 contiguous Sundays/77 transitions/39 entering episodes
Reproduce every old entry index in parent rows
R2 JSON, manifest SHA and readback verified
safety: No live quotes, no orders, no buy/sell, no P&L, Spot, Futures, NAV, capital, reserve, limits, MASTER or detector runtime writes
Retrospective exploratory study, not an out-of-sample validated probability
